label_definition.usefulness: Human gold score from 0 to 10 indicating how useful the review is as evidence about the target product.
label_definition.7-9: Clearly useful product evidence, but less detailed.
label_definition.4-6: Some relevance but vague, generic, or limited evidence.
label_definition.0: Clearly about another product or unrelated subject.

reviews.text: I've used the iPhone 16 Pro Max every day for three months. With 5G, 120Hz enabled, and about 6 to 7 hours of screen-on time, I usually finish the day with 20 to 25% battery remaining.
The 16 Pro Max gets noticeably warm during 30-minute Genshin Impact sessions, and the battery drops roughly 12% during that period. Outside gaming, thermals are normal.
The main camera produces excellent daylight photos, but in low light I see some loss of fine detail when I crop the image. The 5x telephoto is particularly useful for distant subjects.
After six months, the titanium frame has held up well with no visible dents, but the glass back picked up two small scratches despite using a case most of the time.
Charging from 10% to 50% takes about 25 minutes with my 30W USB-C charger. It is not class-leading, but it is fast enough for a short top-up before leaving home.
The display is very bright outdoors and remains readable under direct sunlight. The 120Hz refresh rate also makes scrolling noticeably smoother than my previous 60Hz phone.
I have received the promised software updates so far, and iOS 18 runs smoothly. I have not encountered crashes or serious bugs during normal use.
The speakers are loud and clear for podcasts and videos, although bass becomes thin at maximum volume. There is no noticeable distortion at around 80% volume.
Face ID works reliably even when I unlock the phone in a dark room. It failed twice while wearing a mask.
The phone feels heavy after extended one-handed use. It weighs 227 grams, and I notice the weight especially when reading in bed for more than 30 minutes.
Battery life is very good and easily gets me through a normal workday.
The camera takes great photos and videos, especially during the day.
